definitions.explanation: The medical specialty dealing with pregnancy, childbirth, and diseases of the female reproductive system. Also refers to the hospital department or clinic specializing in this field.

examples.japanese: {産婦人科|さんふじんか}を{受診|じゅしん}する。
{近|ちか}くに{評判|ひょうばん}のいい{産婦人科|さんふじんか}がある。
examples.english: There's a well-regarded OB/GYN clinic nearby.

examples.japanese: {妊娠|にんしん}がわかったので、{産婦人科|さんふじんか}で{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けることにした。
examples.english: Since I found out I was pregnant, I decided to get examined at an OB/GYN.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated to {産科|さんか} (obstetrics) or {婦人科|ふじんか} (gynecology) when referring to one specialty specifically. The combined term {産婦人科|さんふじんか} covers both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産婦人科|さんふじんか}{医|い} (OB/GYN doctor)
- {産婦人科|さんふじんか}に{通|かよ}う (to regularly visit an OB/GYN)
- {産婦人科|さんふじんか}で{出産|しゅっさん}する (to give birth at an OB/GYN)
